metadata.title: Tropical agriculturist and magazine of the Ceylon Agricultural Society
metadata.possible-copyright-status: Public domain. The BHL considers that this work is no longer under copyright protection
metadata.creator: Ceylon Agricultural Society
metadata.notes:
No contents or copyright pages are present. 
Some pages are feint due to occasional light print impressions. 
Pagination generally reflects the individual issues bound together in this volume but occasional irregularities occur.
Tight binding has meant some print falls in the gutter in this volume 
with the pages cut close to the text causing occasional cropping.
There are several larger format foldout pages in this volume which were very fragile. These pages have been photographed at as high a quality as was possible given the nature and state of the material.
